readerCopy.body: A larger opportunity can arrive at the same time a bigger decision is ready to become practical. When Jupiter trines the North Node, expansion and forward movement reinforce each other, making education, travel, publishing, mentorship, a new role, or wider reach especially relevant to what comes next. The useful opportunity changes what becomes possible after the yes. Its scale is easier to trust when the time, money, and responsibilities can carry the larger plan too.
